information:
Pre Registration on WCA website and payment of registration fee is mandatory and closes on 23rd February, 2018, 23:59 BST (GMT+6).
Please visit [Registration and Payment Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DhakaSpringOpen2018#3664-registration-and-payments) for details.
**On The Spot Registration is available from 8:30 to 9:00 on 2nd March, 2018.**
